claim: AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed file transfer service for SFTP, FTPS and FTP; your end users can use their SFTP, FTP or FTPS clients to access data stored in your Amazon EFS file system, and Transfer Family endpoints must be in the same Region as the file system.

evidence.quote: AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed file transfer service that provides support for Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), File Transfer Protocol over SSL (FTPS), and File Transfer Protocol (FTP).
AWS Transfer Family endpoints must be in the same Region as your Amazon EFS file system.
Once complete, your end users can use their SFTP, FTP, or FTPS clients to access data stored in your Amazon EFS file system.
